text: Should the ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute be emitted for netstandard2.0 and .NET Framework targets, or only for newer TFMs?
options: Emit on all targets (drop the #if guard)
Keep the guard, since only newer TFMs are intended to be supported
why_it_matters: If every supported TFM has the attribute, the guard violates the 'all generated code' criterion and should be removed. If the guard is intentional, for example for older TFMs lacking the attribute on types, it stays as is.
